span.div:
Agent clock drifts 5 min ──▶ Timestamps rejected as "too old"
──▶ All metrics from node dropped ──▶ Node goes dark
Mitigation: NTP, clock skew metric + alert

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Agent OOM ──▶ Metrics stop ──▶ Dashboard shows stale data
──▶ No alert fires ──▶ Outage undetected for hours
Mitigation: up{job="...") == absent alert

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Traffic spike ──▶ More metrics ──▶ Aggregator overload
──▶ Slow queries ──▶ Dashboard timeout ──▶ Blind team
Mitigation: 5x over-provision, auto-scaling

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
500 rules ──▶ 150 alerts/day ──▶ On-call ignores alerts
──▶ Real incident missed ──▶ Extended outage while blind
Mitigation: 30-day alert review, signal-to-noise ratio target

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
New label "user_id" ──▶ 1M new series ──▶ Inverted index OOM
──▶ TSDB rejects all writes ──▶ Complete monitoring blackout
Mitigation: 100K series limit per metric at aggregator
